sentences.text: The proposed consolidation of GPS Pekhri-2 into GPS Gushaini would affect 24 students from 4 habitations.
The receiving school is approximately 3.8 km away by road (about 19 minutes by vehicle); the footpath is 4.6 km, an estimated 82 minutes for a young child.
Community feedback identifies transport (31 responses) and seasonal access (19) as recurring concerns, and field evidence reports a seasonal bridge issue on the walking route.
Field verification confirms the river crossing is not reliably passable in heavy rain.
Public transport is not available at school arrival and departure times.
No intervention has been selected yet.
